propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, lacking the transient-read fault recovery available to other store write paths

CI test failures (runs 31340000912, 31349549323, 31558315198) raise 'fatal: bad object HEAD' during bundle creation, indicating the merge commit's loose object became unreadable between ref resolution and object parse
The missing-object condition is proven reproducible by deleting the merge commit object immediately before bundle, but the runner-side trigger remains unproven
S3DoctorConflict error message misdescribes transient object-DB read failures as heads conflicts, directing operators to fsck-recover for a merge that never conflicted
The fix routes s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit per-store advisory lock, retry wrapper, and transient marker handling; bad object signature added to _TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS
